dev.description: Starts Vite and also worker-api so filtered `turbo run dev --filter=front-app` has a live gateway. Interruptible so `turbo watch` can restart when dependency inputs change.

deploy.description: Bootstrap / emergency: uploads ./dist as Cloudflare assets at 100%. Not the recurring Stage 1 main path.

upload.description: Stage 1 versions upload of ./dist; requires this app's production Vite build first.
